name: Ondřej Kolář - Après le § 29 - Am 2
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Bosnia and Herzegovina
part_text: 29a. Stresses that BiH remains a transit and production country for drug trafficking and continues to face serious challenges related to organised crime and Islamist terrorist groups; recalls that these groups also threaten the EU and underlines that strong external border management and effective cross-border cooperation between the EU and BiH are essential to counter these threats;
